## Orchid UI MCP

```text
https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/api/mcp
```

Streamable HTTP. No authentication. Start with `tools/list`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orchid-ui": {
      "url": "https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Tools: `list_orchid_components` (search), then `get_orchid_component` (`install`, props, examples, files).

Registry: `https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/{name}.json` (`npx shadcn@latest add @orchid/<name>`).
